state.description: The state of the button, which decides the indicators that are shown.

disabled.description: Whether the button is disabled, either on its own or because it is loading.

setDisabled.description: Disables or enables the button. A loading button stays disabled.

setLoading.description: Starts or stops loading. A loading button is disabled too.

addEventListener.description: Adds an event listener to the button element, the same as `addEventListener` of the element.

id.description: The unique identifier of the button.

ids.description: The ids of the parts other elements reference: `root`.

loading.description: Whether the button is loading. A loading button is disabled too.

focusableWhenDisabled.description: Keeps a disabled button focusable. It then gets `aria-disabled` instead of the `disabled` attribute, and clicks and key presses are ignored.

Root.data-loading: Present while the button is loading.
